tata-nexon.author: Harshvyas1001
tata-nexon.alt: Tata Nexon (2023 facelift) in white, rear three-quarter view
tata-nexon.note: Post-Sept-2023 facelift: full-width LED tail-lamp bar and spaced NEXON lettering on the tailgate; new unregistered car in India. No .ev badge, so taken to be the petrol/diesel Nexon.

tata-curvv.file: File:2025 Tata Curvv Creative+ S Petrol (India) front view.png
tata-curvv.author: Manish Bhardwaj
tata-curvv.alt: Tata Curvv Creative+ S petrol in grey, front three-quarter view
tata-curvv.note: Still from a 2025 Indian review video of the Curvv petrol (UP-registered): ICE Curvv grille with light bar; current body. Series X (2026) is a line-up/trim change. Original is 1438 px wide.

tata-curvv-ev.author: VideshiBhaktNRI
tata-curvv-ev.alt: Tata Curvv.ev in Pure Grey, rear three-quarter view
tata-curvv-ev.note: CURVV.ev tailgate lettering, aero wheels, Karnataka trade plate (2024). Same body as the current SeriesX Curvv.ev.

tata-harrier.author: Pramodbhardwaj214
tata-harrier.alt: Tata Harrier (2023 facelift) #DARK edition in black, front three-quarter view
tata-harrier.note: Facelift (Oct 2023 on): full-width LED bar, new grille, vertically stacked headlamps; HARRIER showroom plate, photographed in Rajasthan in 2025.

tata-harrier-ev.author: Gpkp
tata-harrier-ev.alt: Tata Harrier.ev in grey, front three-quarter view
tata-harrier-ev.note: Identified as Harrier EV by the photographer (Bangalore auto show, Nov 2025): closed slatted grille panel, full-width LED bar, vertical Harrier headlamp stacks. Show-floor shot; rear of the car is cropped.

tata-safari.author: Gpkp
tata-safari.alt: Tata Safari (2023 facelift) #DARK edition in black, front three-quarter view
tata-safari.note: Facelift (Oct 2023 on): SAFARI plate, new grille and vertical headlamp stacks, black #DARK alloys; Bangalore auto show, Nov 2025. Some show-light reflections.
